observed.caption: Interior of a large arched market hall with a florist kiosk in the foreground.
observed.description: The photo shows the interior of a large hall with high vaulted arches and tall windows along the left wall letting in daylight. In the foreground center is a small enclosed florist kiosk with a white sign reading Pien Florist and phone numbers, decorated with images of flower bouquets and topped with red floral arrangements and cardboard boxes. To the right of the kiosk is a blue barrel holding red flowers and stacks of blue and green tarpaulins. To the left are wooden pallets and shelving with yellow containers. Behind the kiosk is an upper mezzanine level with blue tarpaulin covers, metal railings, and shelves holding dark objects. The far wall is light-colored brick with vertical pilasters, and the ceiling features repeating concrete arches and exposed beams.
